text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text: Alright, General Affairs Committee members, please inspect the cleaning supplies in your assigned areas!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (Let's get this over with quickly so I can train...)

text_block_list.name: General Affairs Committee Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Th-This is bad, Ayabe-san!
In the zone our team was assigned to—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"The count for the cleaning brooms doesn't match what it should be.
We need to search for them."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Looks that way.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I spotted Admire Vega seemingly hard at work on her committee duties.
However, it looks like a problem has arisen...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...It's nothing, just the usual.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Usually, we on the General Affairs Committee
wouldn't struggle this much just inspecting cleaning supplies."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Everyone at Tracen Academy is very well-mannered,
and cleaning contractors visit regularly.
For cleaning supplies to be missing means...
choice_data_list: So there shouldn't be one, huh.
So there shouldn't be one, right?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"Should have," "might have," "what if."
There's no point in speaking in hypotheticals.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Let us finish this quickly.

text_block_list.name: General Affairs Committee Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Ayabe-san, as calm and collected as ever, I see~

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes, as a fellow member of the General Affairs Committee,
I deeply respect her work ethic.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Hence, all of us on the General Affairs Committee
secretly call you that out of deep admiration.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —A true professional, indeed.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Then let us be off as well.
To go help Ayabe-san with her work.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —"Rule one: act with zero wasted motion."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Nunuu~! Even with a broom,
I can't reach the ball stuck in the tree...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Grit!)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I've secured the ball that fell.
To knock it down with a pebble like that—splendid work.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Awesome!
It's the ultimate move: Rising Arrow!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Done? Then give that broom back.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —"Rule one: take control without resisting."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I CAN fly!
I'm a witch, so of course I can!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...If it can't fly, then it's just an ordinary broom.
Isn't that a very witch-like way to tell?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
! Yes, that's it!
Heheh♪ Next time, I'll definitely find that magic broom!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Second broom secured.
Way to follow up and keep the dream alive, too.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
And lastly,
—'Rule one: the finishing touches must be swift and flawless.'

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...Quantity and characteristics both match the list.
Collection complete."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes. But today ended up being another day
where I left most of it to you...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...I just want to go home already.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"Fulfilling my own duties.
That's something all of you are doing as well."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. But still...
Willpower alone isn't enough to maneuver like that.
choice_data_list: So this is the power of a true professional...!
It really is a job that takes patience, huh.
It really is a job that takes patience, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. But still...
Willpower alone isn't enough to maneuver like that.
choice_data_list: So this is the power of a true professional...!
It really is a job that takes patience, huh.
It really is a job that takes patience, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? "The Professional"?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: It seems you were deeply moved as well, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: The ability to produce maximum profit with minimal effort. And the sophistication of never flaunting it.
choice_data_list: It truly lives up to that title!
It truly lives up to that title!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Hey.
What do you mean by nicknames?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I explained the origin of the nickname,
she seemed exasperated, but didn't say
anything more about it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching the committee activities today made me realize that
inventory checking is plain work, but requires great patience.
When I shared my thoughts...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...That applies to you too.
choice_data_list: And she was actually really nice.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: B-But that's...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Whatever. I'm going home.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She didn't say much, but it seemed
she had acknowledged me as well.
That was the impression I got from what happened.
